raw.title: Cut Out, Fold In
raw.everydayGoal: Cut a square out of a large sheet of paper along its thick square outline.
raw.normalExpectation: Closing the blades through paper separates it along the cutting line.
raw.impossibleRule: WHEN the scissors close through the paper, THE paper to the right of the blades ALWAYS folds upright along the blade line instead of separating.
raw.visibleTrigger: The scissors' blades closing through the paper.
raw.whyThisObject: Scissors must close through the paper to cut out the square; that exact operation erects the surrounding paper into walls instead of removing it.
raw.goalRuleRelationship: Each attempted side of the square remains attached and gains an upright outer flap, progressively obstructing access to the remaining outline.
raw.frameZeroDescription: At a low craft table, Mimi holds blunt scissors closed through one side of a thick square outline on a large paper sheet. The outer paper stands upright against the scissors' right blade; the outlined square remains attached beneath Mimi's other hand.

beats.strategy: Mimi opens the scissors, turns the paper a quarter-turn, and closes the blades along the next side of the square.
beats.visibleConsequence: The paper to the blades' right folds upright, leaving two adjoining walls around the still-attached square and a buckled paper corner.
beats.newInformation: Turning the sheet changes which outer flap rises, not whether the scissors cut.

beats.strategy: Mimi tilts the sheet toward herself to reach the third outlined side and closes the scissors through it.
beats.visibleConsequence: A third outer flap folds upright to the blades' right, making a three-sided paper enclosure with the scissors entering through its open side.
beats.newInformation: The remaining open side is now the only unobstructed approach to the outline.

beats.strategy: Mimi slides the open scissors through that gap and positions the blades on the final outlined side, keeping the handles inside the enclosure.
beats.visibleConsequence: As the blades close through the paper, the fourth outer flap folds upright to their right, forming a paper box around the scissors.
beats.newInformation: Completing the outline encloses the tool instead of freeing the square.

beats.strategy: Mimi points the scissors upward inside the box and closes them through the top edge of its front wall to make an exit.
beats.visibleConsequence: The wall section to the blades' right folds inward across the box, leaving the scissors' two handle loops protruding above a paper lid.
beats.newInformation: Trying to cut an escape folds part of the enclosure over the trapped tool.

raw.finalPayoff: The wall section to the blades' right folds inward across the box, leaving the scissors' two handle loops protruding above a paper lid.
raw.loopPotential: No reset; hold on the scissors handles protruding from the folded paper box.
raw.environment: One low craft table in a quiet craft corner, with a single large paper sheet.
raw.providerRationale: The scissors' necessary cutting contact creates attached folds. Reorienting the sheet accumulates walls, and the final attempted escape converts a wall into a lid.
